description: Enables Markdown and HTML import/export in TmNotionEditor's Page Settings panel. Export triggers a file download; import uploads a file and creates a new page. Both options are hidden when this provider is not supplied.

methods.name: ExportPageAsync
methods.description: Exports a single page's content as a Markdown or HTML file stream.

methods.name: ExportPageWithSubpagesAsync
methods.description: Exports a page and all its sub-pages as a ZIP stream.

methods.name: ImportAsync
methods.description: Parses an uploaded file and creates a new page from its content. Returns the newly created page.

parameters.name: targetParentPageId
parameters.description: Parent page for the imported page, or null for root.
